statements.status_notes: HTTP/1.1 chunked-extension request smuggling in Jetty. Fix is published only in Jetty 9.4.60 (HeroDevs commercial extended-support backport); no public OSS release exists on the 9.4.x line. Upstream Apache ZooKeeper 3.8.6 and 3.9.5 still pin jetty.version=9.4.58.v20250814. Mitigation requires either a HeroDevs-licensed jetty-http or a major-version bump to Jetty 10/11/12 (jakarta.servlet API), neither of which is currently validated for ZooKeeper's admin server.
